## Player.rollbackPredictedInputs property

The raw input keys that should be sequenced with rollback prediction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get rollbackPredictedInputs(): readonly RollbackPredictableInput[];
```

## Remarks

Inputs outside this list keep their existing reliable/immediate behavior. Defaults to the stock locomotion set (`w`<!-- -->, `a`<!-- -->, `s`<!-- -->, `d`<!-- -->, `sp`<!-- -->, `sh`<!-- -->, `c`<!-- -->, `jd`<!-- -->).
